The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.28633/2021 registered for offences punishable under Sections 504, 506(B) and 498A of IPC.
2.

During the pendency of the petition, the parties to the lis i.e. husband and wife have settled the dispute amongst themselves and have filed an application under Section 320 of Cr.P.C. seeking compounding of the offences.

Since the NC: 2024:KHC:20198 offences are punishable under Section 498A and not against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the application seeking Sri. Sarvesh Gouda @ T R Sarvesh vs State Of Karnataka on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139241065/
2 compounding, noticing the affidavit filed in support of the said application and closing the proceedings against the petitioner.
3.
